The '''[[Brachi]]an Beastlord''' was a sub-species of [[Gundark/Legends|gundark]] that was particularly vicious. It had a poisonous bite. The Brachian Beastlord was found on the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] [[Lamus]]. One year, one of the creatures attacked a group of eight young [[A'Mar]] who were taking part in the [[Beastlord's Hunt]].
